scope: Representative workflow, consent and supportive-care interaction review of the local cumulative build

observedBrowserChecks.method: Managed cloud browser through CUA; observations reported by the release owner

checks.result: All eight workflow rows measured exactly 66 CSS pixels high, including extravasation. Patient platform and NCCP source disclosures were closed initially. Sustainability was loaded.
Reviewed frames had no horizontal document overflow. The six-column supportive-medicine table scrolls horizontally within its own region.
Guidance and generated-script views were exercised, including selection of the AC phase.
The specialist source-only pathway was checked; it does not substitute a general moderate-risk chemotherapy prescription.
The standalone authored plan and individual-support-plan output were checked without populated medicine orders.
The complete authored SACTCheck consent form was opened and reviewed through the workflow action.

Both branded download controls are visible in the real browser. The handbook control points to handbook.pdf and uses the download attribute. Browser download-event capture timed out; downloaded bytes were not obtained through this browser API.

automatedChecks.method: Local Node and source checks; separate from the observed CUA review

results.coverage: Missing doses, PRRT source-only guard, missing-source fallback, dedicated guidance and exact consent-context routing

results.note: An earlier trailing blank line in homepage CSS was removed; the recheck passed.

verificationLimits: The shell Playwright suites supportive-script-tabs.e2e.cjs and homepage-service-layout.e2e.cjs were not executed in browser mode. CUA observations do not assert that every programmed browser assertion passed.
The local checks ran on Node v24.22.1. Repository CI and Pages workflows specify Node 20; this record does not establish a Node 20 CI run.
A 390px browser viewport is not a physical-device test. Actual phone/tablet, screen-reader and other assistive-technology checks were not performed in this review.
Physical printing and browser-generated script PDF pagination were not verified here. The separately generated patient documents have their own document-verification record.
Deployment, production routing and production cache behaviour were not verified. This was a local cumulative-build review.

Browser download-event capture for the newly added handbook control did not complete in the managed browser. A separate attempt to reach that managed preview via executor localhost was refused. Static href targets, source and build-output existence, full PDF contents and mirrored bytes are verified separately; no successful browser download capture or local-preview HTTP byte check is claimed.
